kalanso-kunafoni.summary: All-in-one platform to manage the administration, teaching and finances of a school.
kalanso-kunafoni.description: Kalanso Kunafoni brings together a school’s administration, teaching follow-up and financial management in a single platform. Management, office staff and teachers work from the same up-to-date information, without multiplying registers and files.

a.title: Administration
a.text: Student records and school organisation, gathered in one place.

b.title: Teaching
b.text: Class and student results follow-up, shared with the teaching team.

c.title: Finances
c.text: Tracking of school fees and payments, for a clear view of the finances.

stockautoplus.summary: Stock management application to track products, incoming and outgoing goods.
stockautoplus.description: StockAutoPlus automates stock management: every incoming and outgoing movement is recorded, and the stock level of each product is known at all times. Businesses and warehouses save time and reduce inventory discrepancies.

a.title: Products
a.text: A product catalogue with available quantities.

b.title: Incoming and outgoing goods
b.text: Every movement is recorded and stock is updated automatically.

c.title: Monitoring
c.text: A clear view of stock status to decide faster.

about.title: Digital solutions that serve organisations
about.intro: TSD Systems designs and sells digital solutions for schools, businesses and agricultural value chains.
about.mission1: Give organisations simple, reliable tools to run their day-to-day activity: less paper, fewer scattered files, up-to-date and shared information.
about.mission2: Our solutions are built for teams with little time to spend on IT: they must be clear from the very first use.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Readable screens, plain words, explanations everyone can understand.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: Tools you can count on every day, with data handled with care.

listening.title: Listening
listening.text: The needs expressed by users guide how each solution evolves.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Clear commitments and a direct relationship with the founders.

about.nameText: The name TSD Systems comes from the initials of its three founders: Tandjigora, Sanogo and Diallo.

team.title: The founders
team.intro: TSD Systems was founded by three partners. The initials of their names make up the company’s name.
